description: NOBIL - ladestasjoner for elbiler is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by info.nobil.no. NOBIL er etablert for formidling av informasjon om ladestasjoner for elbiler. Den har et detaljert innhold om ladestasjonene og formidler sanntidsdata. Alt er fritt tilgjengelig via et API. Et ladepunkt er en reservert parkeringsplass med lademulighet for ladbare kjøretøy. Coverage: NO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2018-03-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/no/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
